sloka: तच्चास्य बलमादास्ये बलेन महता वृतः ।ज्योतिषामिव सर्वेषाम् प्रभामुद्यन्दिवाकरः ॥६-२४-४०॥।।
transliteration: taccāsya balamādāsye balena mahatā vṛtaḥ ।jyotiṣāmiva sarveṣām prabhāmudyandivākaraḥ ॥6-24-40॥।।

translations.english: "Just as the rising Sun light obscures the radiance of all (other stars) when will I obscure him surrounded by his army?"
